exposure: prolonged expectant management of preterm hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (duration between diagnosis and delivery: >7 days vs. <=7 days)
outcome: admission for a composite of cardiovascular disease
cohort: Patients from New York State who had their first preterm delivery between 2005 and 2014 and were diagnosed with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
finding: Prolonged expectant management of preterm hypertensive disorders of pregnancy is associated with an increased risk of maternal cardiovascular morbidity in the years after delivery.
